title: per-request reqwest::Client in ActivityPub delivery — connection-pool exhaustion under load
description: deliver_article (outbound.rs:131), deliver_accept (inbox.rs:189), and fetch_public_key (inbound.rs:208) each call reqwest::Client::new() per invocation. reqwest clients maintain their own connection pools; creating one per delivery bypasses connection reuse, DNS caching, and TLS session resumption. Under moderate follower counts or signature-verification traffic, this causes O(n) connection overhead per article. This will generate performance bug reports from operators running more than a few hundred followers. A shared reqwest::Client should be stored in ActivityPubState.
